description: Kenya: changes to the General Roman Calendar for the dioceses of Kenya (Kenya Conference of Catholic Bishops). Researched for L-015 from GCatholic.org, which publishes the Kenyan calendar; the KCCB Ordo itself is not published online. Every entry that is not "confirmed" waits for sign-off against the KCCB Ordo (L-209).

source.title: GCatholic.org, Liturgical Calendar — Kenya (2026), compared with its General Roman Calendar (2026)

epiphanyOnSunday.notes: Epiphany on the Sunday between 2 and 8 January (4 January 2026). GCatholic.org lists it on Sunday for Kenya in 2025, 2026 and 2027; not yet checked against the KCCB Ordo.

source.title: GCatholic.org, Liturgical Calendar — Kenya (2026), compared with its General Roman Calendar (2026)

ascensionOnSunday.notes: Ascension on the Seventh Sunday of Easter (17 May 2026). GCatholic.org lists it on Sunday for Kenya in 2025, 2026 and 2027; not yet checked against the KCCB Ordo.

source.title: GCatholic.org, Liturgical Calendar — Kenya (2026), compared with its General Roman Calendar (2026)

corpusChristiOnSunday.notes: Corpus Christi on the Sunday after Trinity Sunday (7 June 2026). GCatholic.org lists it on Sunday for Kenya in 2025, 2026 and 2027; not yet checked against the KCCB Ordo.

source.title: GCatholic.org, Liturgical Calendar — Kenya (2026), compared with its General Roman Calendar (2026)
